runs.final_sql: SELECT c.gndr FROM clnt c JOIN dsp d ON d.ref1 = c.clnt_id AND d.typ = 'OWNER' JOIN acct a ON a.accn_id = d.ref2 JOIN dstr ds ON ds.dstr_id = a.ref1 WHERE ds.a11 = (SELECT MAX(a11) FROM dstr) ORDER BY c.brth_dt ASC LIMIT 1

runs.final_sql: SELECT SUM(t.amnt) AS total_paid FROM clnt c JOIN dsp d ON c.clnt_id = d.ref1 AND d.typ = 'OWNER' JOIN acct a ON d.ref2 = a.accn_id JOIN trns t ON t.ref1 = a.accn_id WHERE c.clnt_id = 617 AND YEAR(t.dt) = 1998
